== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b8af2d419a63b6a0edcf32c2b298935e403013c3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/icantbelievehesgone.gif Holotable image repository, commit b8af2d4] “June 1 2023 Errata”, 31 May 2023, for the PC's June 1, 2023 errata. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
